_comment: Concrete ids for the mobile app's dynamic routes, so the dogfood sweep exercises them instead of skipping them. Before this file existed the sweep's route list was a hand-made /tmp file that omitted all 8 dynamic routes, so every detail screen in the app was unmeasured while the summary still read '223 routes'.
_ownership: EVERY id here must belong to whichever user the SIMULATOR is signed in as. The API scopes by owner and answers not-found for someone else's row, which is indistinguishable from a broken screen. This is not hypothetical: the first version of this file held ids owned by dogios@fynvita.test while the simulator was signed in as m@t.co, and /student-loans/[id] and /trading/strategies/[id] both reported 'not found' against rows that existed and were perfectly healthy. The sweep now PREFLIGHTS this by reading the signed-in email off the Profile screen and refuses to run on a mismatch, because a comment did not prevent it.
_unseeded: /reports/[id], /student-loans/[id] and /monitoring/alerts/[id] have no entry on purpose: credit_reports, student_loans and credit_alerts each hold ZERO rows for this user. Borrowing another user's id would produce a not-found that reads exactly like a broken screen — the very mistake described above. They are reported as UNSEEDED so the coverage gap stays visible rather than being quietly dropped or silently faked.
_reseed: Re-seed after `supabase db reset`, or after signing the simulator in as a different user — the ids AND _ownerEmail must move together. A stale id shows up as a not-found state, not a silent pass.
